question: Translating the line \(y=kx+b\) downward by 2 units gives \(y=-3x+4\). Find the value of \(k+b\).
solution: Translation does not change \(k\), so \(k=-3\). Translating the original line downward by 2 units gives \(y=kx+b-2\), so \(b-2=4\), \(b=6\), and \(k+b=3\).
